name: Cosmos Internet Services
summary: Melbourne low-cost dialup then hosting/data-centre provider; acquired by Mikka International 2001, still operating under Cosmos name.

events.details: Acquired by Mikka International (2001), still trading as Cosmos Internet Services (cosmos.net.au: 'Mikka International (trading as) Cosmos Internet Services', ABN 97 075 155 225). ABR confirms MIKKA INTERNATIONAL PTY. LTD. (ACN 075 155 225) active with business name COSMOS INTERNET SERVICES. Prior 'death c.2005' record was fabricated boilerplate and has been removed.
